The OpenSearch domain references its security group, but AWS requires the OpenSearch service-linked role to exist before domain creation; the domain has no dependency on the role. Add an explicit dependency (a role ARN cannot be used as a meaningful domain input here).

The managed Prometheus workspace can be provisioned in parallel with the EKS cluster, although the module receives the cluster ID; the workspace alias may be cluster-derived and this usage expresses a dependency only through a derived local. No explicit module ordering ensures cluster creation precedes workspace provisioning.
